## Where things stand
Implemented the dashboards v2 grid with drag-and-resize, per-dashboard server-side layout persistence and a localStorage fallback. Widget sizing uses ResizeObserver for iOS 15 compatibility; v1 remains available behind the flag. Draft PR #418 is open, awaiting UX review.

- [in-progress] Priya’s iPad UX review is pending.
- [next-step] Enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace in the flags admin, then prepare for the Tuesday 24th demo.
- [decision] Keep v1 dashboards available until January; remove nothing now. (source: t15)
- [decision] Use ResizeObserver sizing and drop container queries. (source: t09)
